important.name: The installed mod keeps writing the old usage log after TASK-1 moves it
important.summary: .claude/settings.json enables the published marketplace, so sessions on this branch run main's pr-review-watch 0.5.1. .claude/harness.json sets no agent_usage_path, so that mod appends to the old default docs/_harness/pr_review_agent_usage.jsonl. After TASK-1's git mv, the next Agent dispatch on the branch (a review run like this one, for example) recreates the old file. The rows then split across two logs, the planned test_the_usage_log_moved (`not (REPO_ROOT / OLD_LOG).exists()`) fails in the developer checkout, and canned_messages no longer covers the old name once LOOKUP is renamed. No task folds those rows back or pins the path for the branch's lifetime.
fix: In TASK-1, set `"agent_usage_path": "docs/_harness/agent_usage.jsonl"` in .claude/harness.json so the installed mod writes the new path at once, and add a closing step that removes the override after the merge.
Add a final step before the merge that appends any rows found in docs/_harness/pr_review_agent_usage.jsonl to docs/_harness/agent_usage.jsonl and deletes the old file.

important.name: Planned test_agent_watcher_name.py walks the tree without WALK_ROOTS
important.summary:
TASK-2 step 8 copies the planned tests/contract/test_agent_watcher_name.py. That file calls `(MOD / "hooks").glob("**/tracker.ts")` and runs `git grep` over the whole repo, but declares no module-level WALK_ROOTS. Once it lands, tests/scripts/test_select_tests.py::test_every_walking_test_declares_existing_walk_roots fails with 'walking tests need a literal WALK_ROOTS tuple'. TASK-2's verify command does not run test_select_tests.py, so the break first shows in CI. The sibling planned test_agent_watcher_layers.py does declare WALK_ROOTS. The planned file is gitignored (docs/plans/**/*.py), so the fix lands in that local file and in the plan's step text.

Also (overall): TASK-2 step 8 copies the planned tests/contract/test_agent_watcher_name.py, whose test_the_owner_note_names_agent_watcher calls `(MOD / "hooks").glob("**/tracker.ts")`. tools/select_tests.py TREE_WALK matches `.glob(`, and the planned file declares no module-level WALK_ROOTS, so tests/scripts/test_select_tests.py::test_every_walking_test_declares_existing_walk_roots fails once TASK-2 lands. The test also runs `git grep` over the whole repo, a route the selector cannot see. TASK-2's verify list leaves out test_select_tests.py, so the break first shows up in CI, which selects that test for any new file under tests/.

Also (overall): Sweep S1 marks docs/PROVENANCE.md `TASK-2: rename to agent-watcher` and TASK-2 step 5 lists it. Its only hit, line 40, is `| .claude/mods/{pr-review-watch,session-bookmark}/** | plugins/{pr-review-watch,session-bookmark}/ |`, and the left column is the path in the source repository, which keeps its name. A blanket rename breaks the CLAUDE.md contract that PROVENANCE maps every imported file back to its source. The planned test_no_live_file_names_the_old_mod excludes neither docs/PROVENANCE.md nor any line in it, so the test requires that wrong edit.

Also (overall): TASK-2 removes `pr-review-watch` from the marketplace, and TASK-1 changes the agent_usage_path default. A consuming project that enabled `pr-review-watch@operator-straps` (README.md:110 tells users to install it under that name) loses the mod on the next marketplace update without any warning. Its existing docs/_harness/pr_review_agent_usage.jsonl stops growing while new rows go to agent_usage.jsonl. No task adds a migration note. The planned test_no_live_file_names_the_old_mod fails any live file that names the old mod, so a README migration note cannot land as the plan stands.
fix: Add `WALK_ROOTS = (".",)` to docs/plans/0006/tests/tests/contract/test_agent_watcher_name.py, because test_no_live_file_names_the_old_mod greps every file and has to run on any change. Add tests/scripts/test_select_tests.py to the TASK-2 verify pytest command.

Add `WALK_ROOTS = (".",)` to the planned docs/plans/0006/tests/tests/contract/test_agent_watcher_name.py (the git grep covers the whole repo), and add tests/scripts/test_select_tests.py to TASK-2 step 8's pytest command.

Drop the glob: read `MOD / "hooks" / "tracker.ts"` in TASK-2 and let TASK-3 repoint it to `hooks/core/tracker.ts`. The git grep still needs a `(".",)` marker so the selector runs the test on any change.

important.name: TASK-3 Layer contract has no hook for the reviewer owner note
important.summary:
TASK-3 splits pr-review behavior out of core, but its Layer interface (identify, rowFields, onSettle returning void, stopReason) gives a layer no way to add context to the Agent tool result. Today the pr-review owner note is appended there: tracker.ts:571-573 checks `d.skill === 'pr-review' && d.role === 'reviewer'`, calls `ownsRows($, d.runId)` and returns `{ ...r, context: [..., OWNER_NOTE] }`. That leaves two outcomes. The executor keeps pr-review-specific logic in hooks/core/tracker.ts, against the generic-core layout. Or the executor invents an unplanned interface member. The planned TASK-2 test `test_the_owner_note_names_agent_watcher` also pins OWNER_NOTE to a file matching `hooks/**/tracker.ts`. Moving the note into layers/pr-review/ (its natural home) turns that test red after TASK-3, and TASK-3's verify list does not rerun TASK-2's nodes.

Also (docs): TASK-3 moves bubbles.ts to hooks/layers/pr-review/, and config.ts and root.ts to hooks/core/ (config splits in two). Three references outside the mod's README and tests are not in TASK-3's files: plugins/bubble-stamp/hooks/review.ts:3 cites `pr-review-watch/hooks/bubbles.ts`, which TASK-2 renames to agent-watcher/hooks/bubbles.ts and which goes stale after TASK-3; .claude/skills/porting-into-straps/SKILL.md:34 points to the `config.ts` / `root.ts` patterns of the mod; CLAUDE.md says a mod mirrors defaults in its `hooks/config.ts`, which no longer holds for agent-watcher once its mirror spans core/config.ts and layers/pr-review/config.ts. test_no_live_file_names_the_old_mod only catches the old mod name, not stale paths.

Also (docs): TASK-1 lists both ends of each `git mv`. TASK-2 lists only the new tests/mods/test_agent_watcher_*.py names, not the three old test_pr_review_watch_*.py names. TASK-3 lists neither the hooks/*.ts files it removes (tracker, contract, config, usageRow, matrixRow, phase5Scan, band, bubbles, runKey, runs, sentinels, watch, root) nor the moved unit tests (core/contract.test.ts, core/usageRow.test.ts, layers/pr-review/*.test.ts). plan.py commit_problems (plan.py:355-368) checks drift only on listed paths, so `record` will not flag a stray uncommitted edit or leftover file at those paths.

Also (overall): TASK-3 says each *.test.ts moves beside its file, but its files list has none of the seven moved tests (bubbles, config, contract, phase5Scan, runKey, runs, sentinels). TASK-4 then lists hooks/core/contract.test.ts and hooks/core/usageRow.test.ts as existing files. config.test.ts has no single destination, because TASK-3 splits config.ts into core/config.ts and layers/pr-review/config.ts. `lanes` overlap and the record check both read this list.

Also (overall): CLAUDE.md:17 says a mod mirrors a key's default in 'that mod's `hooks/config.ts`'. TASK-3 moves agent-watcher's mirrors into hooks/core/config.ts and hooks/layers/pr-review/config.ts and does not list CLAUDE.md, so the rule points at a file that no longer exists.
fix: Through plan.py, add a member such as `resultContext?(io, run, agent, result) => Promise<string[]>` to the TASK-3 Layer interface. State that OWNER_NOTE and ownsRows move to hooks/layers/pr-review/layer.ts. Widen the planned TASK-2 test's search from `**/tracker.ts` to `**/*.ts`.
Or state in TASK-3 that OWNER_NOTE and the reviewer ownership check stay in hooks/core/tracker.ts as a named exception to the generic core, so the TASK-2 test keeps holding.

Add plugins/bubble-stamp/hooks/review.ts, .claude/skills/porting-into-straps/SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md to TASK-3 files, with a step that points each one at its new hooks/core/ or hooks/layers/pr-review/ path.
Through plan.py, add the old paths and the moved test destinations to TASK-2 and TASK-3 `files`, as TASK-1 does.

Add the moved test paths (hooks/core/contract.test.ts, hooks/core/usageRow.test.ts, hooks/layers/pr-review/{bubbles,phase5Scan,runKey,runs,sentinels,matrixRow}.test.ts, and the split config tests) to TASK-3's files, and say where config.test.ts's cases go.
Add CLAUDE.md to TASK-3's files, with a step that names agent-watcher's two config files in the mirror rule.

important.name: TASK-4 `fields` rule contradicts 'a pr-review slot dispatch logs exactly as before'
important.summary:
TASK-4 step 3 says a row's `fields` holds every leading-block key core did not consume, and core consumes only the skill key, RUN_ID, ROLE and AGENT_ID. A pr-review reviewer prompt opens with AGENT_ID, AGENT_ROLE, RUN_ID and PR, and the pr-review identify reads MODE as well. Under step 3, AGENT_ROLE and PR (and MODE where present) land in `fields`, yet step 6 requires that a pr-review slot dispatch logs exactly as before. The plan never says whether keys a claiming layer consumes are excluded, so the opus executor has to pick a row shape the plan does not state.

Also (overall): TASK-4 step 2 has core read `AGENT_ID` but `ROLE`. The slot header (contract.ts:109) and the return block (contract.ts:179) use `AGENT_ROLE`. An unclaimed dispatch that follows the repo's established `AGENT_ID`/`AGENT_ROLE` header logs role `other` and stores AGENT_ROLE in `fields`. No decision records why the key differs.

Also (overall): README.md:40 ('every dispatch of an agent this marketplace defines') and README.md:429 ('one usage row per defined-agent dispatch') describe the gate that TASK-4 removes. TASK-1 and TASK-2 touch README.md only for the path and the name, and TASK-4's files (plugin README only) leave out the root README.

Also (overall): TASK-4 step 3 copies every unconsumed leading-block value into `fields` as written. The strap runner row puts `TREE: <abs worktree>` and `INIT: <hpy launcher path> init ...` there, and the bubble-memo investigator row adds FILES and CONTEXT (up to CONTEXT_MAX characters). docs/_harness/agent_usage.jsonl is tracked, so absolute local paths and free text enter repo history on every dispatch.
fix: Through plan.py, amend TASK-4 step 3 to say `fields` excludes every key the claiming layer consumes (pr-review: RUN_ID, MODE, AGENT_ROLE, AGENT_ID, PR), or that layer-claimed rows carry no `fields`. Add to step 6 a TS assertion that a pr-review slot row has no `fields` key.
Have core read `AGENT_ROLE` (optionally accepting `ROLE` as an alias) in TASK-4 step 2, or record the choice as a decision with its rationale.
Add README.md to TASK-4's files, and in step 7 reword lines 40 and 429 to say every Agent dispatch is logged.
Cap each field value (for example 200 characters) in core/usageRow.ts and the schema (maxLength), or record a decision that accepts paths and free text in the committed log.
